notes.title: Release Notes for 1.0.3
notes.content:
▹ Resolving one story line should be less frustrating
▹ Clean up conflicts between some events
▹ Fixed some event conditions
▹ A clan can only be swallowed up by Chaos once
▹ Gods don’t award fractional livestock
▹ More advice for some events
▹ Clarified some prompts
▹ Fixed some issues where the UI didn’t update
▹ Streamline continuing games on Windows

notes.title: A Quick Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who’s played the game! We’ve been working on it for years and it’s really great to see people enjoying it. (Yes, I read the reviews.)

We just released version 1.0.1, which fixes a number of bugs that the Quality Assurance team and our beta testers found after we finished version 1.0. Most of these handle unusual circumstances, like a character dying while in a spirit-induced coma or when about to make a divination, or someone exploring their former homeland. Some related to making advice more relevant (for example, with a child king). In addition, Harsh games now start with a feud (based on our analysis of beta test games).

We have a few more fixes and enhancements in the works. If you run into something that bugs you, https://sixages.com/resources/ has info on the best way to report it.

David

notes.title: A Quick Update (21 Aug 2023, version 1.0.1)
notes.content:
We just released version 1.0.1, which fixes a number of bugs that QA and our beta testers found after we finished version 1.0. Most of these handle unusual circumstances, like a character dying while in a spirit-induced coma or when about to make a divination, or someone exploring their former homeland. Some related to making advice more relevant (for example, with a child king). On iOS, we made sure that all achievements can be earned. In addition, Harsh games now start with a feud (based on our analysis of beta test games).

We’ll no doubt be making additional fixes. If you run into something that bugs you, https://sixages.com/resources/ has info on the best way to report it.
